_comment: The order in which new words appear in «مرور» (the code is reviewPool in src/js/learn.js). Two simple rules. (1) "first": the most useful everyday words come first for every learner, in exactly this order; the lines follow the first lessons (greetings, help, emergency, the numbers to twenty and the tens used in prices, money, days and times, the body and the pharmacy, the months for a date of birth). These are the words that have places kept for them every day — three a day whatever else is waiting (srs.js) — so a learner who does one short set a day has met all of them in about six weeks. Only level 1 words; a spelling that exists twice (the word I, the letter I) means the first one in vocabulary.json. (2) "afterLesson": once a lesson is finished, its word groups (the categories of vocabulary.json) join in: three words from each group in turn, so that every topic the learner has practised keeps moving and the words of a lesson just finished arrive straight away. Easier words always come first: no level 2 word before a level 1 word. Groups whose lesson is not finished yet follow in the same way. A lesson that is not listed adds no group. The alphabet is not listed on purpose: its category is marked "last" in vocabulary.json and comes after every other word, because the learner spells their own name from their own card («اطلاعات من»).
